_comment: Independent staged branch, UseStochExit=0. Stochastic entry remains mandatory. The entry phase jointly sweeps the FVG lower-bound filter, gap size and stochastic period. Run both branch files separately on identical windows. 40+16+80=136 evaluations per training window. Early pruning is heuristic and may discard useful entry/exit interactions. ATRPeriod and MaxWaitBars retain ticker defaults. Not calibrated.
